name: Izzi Art

features.name: Chance x2 and buy
features.description: Improve your odds or buy the bonus where permitted.

review:
The Bonanza engine in a modern art gallery – a 'Monno Liza', customised busts and Medusa all paying anywhere on a 6x5 grid. Very tongue-in-cheek.

Four or more scatters open a museum after-party with up to 30 free spins and random 2x to 100x multipliers. High volatility, 10,200x max and 96.11% RTP. Free spins roughly once every 398 spins. Plays like Aztec Magic Bonanza – the art theme is the difference.
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 398 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
